identity: An illustrated children's-magazine feature in the series 'رحالة ومغامرون' — written by Muhammad Amin, drawn by Alaa el-Din Saad — episode 'عالم يتحدى النكبات', a five-paragraph life of Ibn Khaldun: the Yemeni-Andalusian ancestry, birth in Tunis 1332, the plague that killed his father, twenty years of chancery service, prison and intrigue, the voyage to Cairo, the drowning of his family, the negotiation with Timur in Damascus, and his death in 1406.
